meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会从你的 NanoClaw fork 里提取自定义改动,写成一份可复现的 markdown 迁移指南,再在干净的上游代码上重新应用这些改动来完成升级。升级前会建回滚点,且不改数据目录。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游新版本、又不想处理 git merge 冲突时触发。若已有迁移指南,它会提议直接跳到 Upgrade 阶段。

say.text: 帮我从当前 fork 提取自定义改动,生成迁移指南。
say.note: 会先检查工作区是否干净再开始。

say.text: 我有迁移指南了,直接升级到上游最新版。
say.note: 会在 worktree 里验证后再应用到现有安装。

say.text: 先看看这次升级的改动范围和复杂程度。

howto.what_en: Claude extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a markdown migration guide, then reapplies them on a clean upstream base to upgrade, avoiding merge conflicts. It creates a rollback point and leaves data dirs untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to upgrade a NanoClaw fork to a newer upstream without resolving git merge conflicts. If a guide already exists, Claude offers to skip straight to the Upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: It checks for a clean working tree first.

say_en.text: I already have a guide — go straight to the upgrade.
say_en.note: It validates in a worktree before touching your install.

say_en.text: First assess the scope and complexity of this upgrade.
say_en.note: It may suggest /update-nanoclaw for small scopes.
